column1: # SAMPLE MANIFEST  — one row per short-read sample you want in the panel.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Fill this in. The pipeline reads BAM/CRAM by REMOTE region-slicing (samtools),
# so data_url must support HTTP range requests or be an s3:// path.
# sample_id       Your label for the sample. Must be unique. Used in filenames.
# vamos_column    EXACT column header for this sample in the vamos VCF, e.g.
# cohort          Free text (HPRC, HGSVC2, 1kGP, ...). For your own grouping.
# data_url        URL or s3:// URI of the BAM or CRAM.
# index_url       URL/URI of the .bai/.crai. Leave as '.' to assume
# align_reference Key into references.tsv naming the FASTA the reads were
#                 aligned to (required for CRAM; also fixes contig naming).
# md5             Optional expected md5 of the data file ('.' to skip).
